messages.content: Reply with exactly OK. Do not call a tool.

function.description: Read sales for the distributor bound by trusted request metadata; distributor_id is deliberately not an argument. Returns at most 50 product rows and explicit totals/truncation. Example calls: {"period":"2026Q3"} or {"period":"2026Q2"}.
function.name: query_sales

function.description: Ask the distributor one question on this request's own thread, then end your turn: their answer comes back later as the stranger's text. Only for a fact the request needs and only they have. The thread is bound from the request. A question you write waits for the operator's approval before it goes out; code adds the line saying an agent wrote it.
function.name: ask_stranger

function.description: Send a drafted report email (its pending_id from draft_report_email) to this request's own contact. Irreversible: it waits for the operator's approval, and only a draft for this request's contact can be sent. Call it only when the operator asked for the email to be sent.
function.name: send_report_email

function.description: Search the tool catalogue by what you need to do (for example "chart" or "ask the distributor"). Returns up to 3 tool names; their definitions join your next request. Says when nothing matched.
function.name: search_tools

function.description: Run a short Python program for a step that loops over many results. Inside it, call(name, args) calls one of this request's tools and returns its result envelope ({ok, output, is_error, error}); assign the one value you need to `result`. Only `result` comes back, with the count of calls. No network and no files. At most 8000 characters.
function.name: run_program
